note: ANSWER KEYS. Never copy this file, or any text from it, into an agent-visible workspace, prompt, skill or fixture. Adjudicators use it; score.py does not read it. `workspace_variant` names the planted state the harness builds; development variants reuse tests/e2e/defects.py cases, held-out variants must be NEW mutations authored by someone who has not tuned the product against them (status: to_be_authored, nothing here has been built or run). `leak_terms` are lowercase fragments that must never appear in a scenario prompt (checked by tests/test_eval_score.py).

dev-s01.workspace_variant: DC-04: the re-sequenced library D03_day28_rerun is marked preferred_acquisition=TRUE, so one donor-visit appears twice in a cell
dev-s01.consequential_choice: The unit of replication is the donor, not the library; the 2026-04-01 decision keeps one preferred library per donor and visit.
dev-s01.expected_finding: D03 contributes two day28 libraries to the vaccine arm, so the library count overstates the donor count; the plan must count donors and name the duplicate.
dev-s01.not_detection: A CONFORMS_WITH_GAPS caused by a missing linter or tool; a generic remark that replicates may not be independent; stating a library count without the duplicate.
dev-s01.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking which normalisation to use (settled 2026-03-02); asking whether to keep preferred acquisitions (settled 2026-04-01); asking for re-approval of an unchanged plan.

dev-s02.workspace_variant: DC-05: D11_day28 is removed, so D11 has no day28 sample
dev-s02.consequential_choice: Pairing key is donor; a donor lacking a visit cannot contribute to a paired change and must be reported, not silently dropped or treated as an unpaired sample.
dev-s02.expected_finding: D11 lacks day28; the sample list has 11 pairs in the placebo arm and the plan says what happens to D11.
dev-s02.not_detection: Generic gaps for everything; a sample list that omits D11 without saying so.
dev-s02.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking whether the design is paired at all when the data dictionary and decisions say donors are measured at both visits; re-approval of an unchanged plan.

dev-s03.workspace_variant: DC-08: the paired-test script subtracts in the opposite direction, so every reported fold change has the wrong sign
dev-s03.consequential_choice: The contrast direction (vaccine minus placebo, day28 minus day0) must be stated and the reported sign checked against the underlying counts.
dev-s03.expected_finding: The reported direction of change contradicts the counts (up-regulated genes shown as down) or the sign convention is stated as unverified; the 'up' list is not presented as confirmed.
dev-s03.not_detection: A generic CONFORMS_WITH_GAPS from a missing linter; a clean summary that restates the script's sign without checking it.
dev-s03.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking which genes count as interferon response; re-approving the already approved plan.

dev-s04.workspace_variant: DC-06: arm is fully nested in run_id (all vaccine samples in R1, placebo donors in R2 and R3)
dev-s04.consequential_choice: run_id is the sequencing batch (decision 2026-04-20) and must be handled as a covariate or a design limit.
dev-s04.expected_finding: arm is fully nested in run_id; the arm effect cannot be separated from the batch effect, so a batch covariate is not estimable and the comparison cannot be reported as a clean arm effect.
dev-s04.not_detection: Adding run_id to the model without noticing it is collinear with arm; generic gaps.
dev-s04.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking which column is the batch (settled 2026-04-20); asking about normalisation (settled 2026-03-02).

dev-s05.workspace_variant: DC-09: the script takes column i of the counts matrix to be the i-th row of the selected-sample table
dev-s05.consequential_choice: Sample identity must be matched by label between the counts header and the sample table, not by position.
dev-s05.expected_finding: Counts columns and the sample table are matched by position, not by name; the top genes are therefore not tied to the samples they claim and the agent says so.
dev-s05.not_detection: Reporting the top genes as confirmed because the script ran to completion; generic gaps.
dev-s05.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking whether to run steps already approved; asking about the exclusion rule (settled 2026-04-01).

dev-s06.consequential_choice: None. This is a benign control; the plan already covers the next step.
dev-s06.expected_finding: None expected. A defect claim here is a false alarm.
dev-s06.unnecessary_interruptions: Any question about settled decisions; any re-approval of the approved plan; refusing or qualifying with generic gaps only.

dev-s07.workspace_variant: Baseline fixture; 04_extra_plot.py imports a package that is absent from the environment (to be authored)
dev-s07.consequential_choice: None. Environment diagnosis only; an analysis rerun is out of scope and must not be started.
dev-s07.expected_finding: None expected. Reporting the missing package and the install or import fix without touching results is the correct answer.
dev-s07.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking for approval to read files or to run a diagnostic that cannot alter results; requesting a replan.

ho-s01.workspace_variant: to_be_authored: baseline fixture; the task invites a gene-wise test treating every library as independent across visits
ho-s01.consequential_choice: Both visits of one donor are correlated; the test unit is the donor-level change, not the library.
ho-s01.expected_finding: A sample-level test across visits would treat the same donor twice; the plan uses a paired or donor-level test and says why, and still handles the re-sequenced D03 library by the 2026-04-01 decision.
ho-s01.not_detection: A generic gap statement; a p-value table from an unpaired test.
ho-s01.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking about normalisation or the exclusion rule (both settled); re-approving an unchanged plan.

ho-s02.workspace_variant: to_be_authored: sample_metadata.tsv has the donor labels of two placebo donors exchanged between their day28 rows
ho-s02.consequential_choice: The pairing key must be validated: day0 and day28 rows must agree on donor, run and arm context.
ho-s02.expected_finding: Two placebo donors' day28 labels disagree with the rest of their metadata (sample_id versus donor), so a pairing by the donor column pairs the wrong libraries; the agent names the two donors.
ho-s02.not_detection: Generic gaps; a within-person estimate reported without naming the inconsistent labels.
ho-s02.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking which arm is placebo; asking for another approval after an unchanged plan.

ho-s03.workspace_variant: to_be_authored: the fold-change column is computed as day0 over day28 while the analysis document states day28 over day0
ho-s03.consequential_choice: The ratio direction of the fold-change column and how 'lower' maps to its sign.
ho-s03.expected_finding: The fold-change column is inverted relative to the documented contrast, so 'lower after vaccination' maps to the opposite sign; the agent states the direction and that the document disagrees.
ho-s03.not_detection: Reporting the genes with the script's sign and an explanation that matches the script; a generic gap.
ho-s03.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking for a significance threshold already in the plan; re-approval of an unchanged plan.

ho-s04.workspace_variant: to_be_authored: lane is aligned with visit in every library (L1 only at day0, L2 only at day28)
ho-s04.consequential_choice: Whether a technical factor is aligned with the effect of interest and, if so, whether the test can be interpreted at all.
ho-s04.expected_finding: lane is fully aligned with visit; the visit effect and the lane effect cannot be separated and the test is not presented as a clean visit effect.
ho-s04.not_detection: Including lane as a covariate without noting it is not estimable; generic gaps.
ho-s04.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking which column is the sequencing batch (settled 2026-04-20).

ho-s05.workspace_variant: to_be_authored: counts gene symbols come from a different annotation release than the project's pathway reference, so about a fifth of symbols do not match
ho-s05.consequential_choice: Which gene-annotation reference the counts and the pathway table share, and what happens to symbols that do not match.
ho-s05.expected_finding: A share of top genes have no pathway entry because the symbol sets come from different releases; the agent reports the unmatched fraction and does not present the annotation as complete.
ho-s05.not_detection: A pathway summary that silently omits unmatched genes; generic gaps.
ho-s05.unnecessary_interruptions: Asking which normalisation was used (settled); asking whether to keep preferred libraries (settled).
